name: realtimedatabase_set_data
description: Use this to write data to the specified location in a Firebase Realtime Database.

databaseUrl.description: connect to the database at url. If omitted, use default database instance <project>-default-rtdb.us-central1.firebasedatabase.app. Can point to emulator URL (e.g. localhost:6000/<instance>)

path.description: The path to the data to read. (ex: /my/cool/path)
